appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Number of New Tourists'.
The x-axis has tick marks for each year from 1880 to 1891.
A single blue line represents the trend of new tourists over time.
The data line begins at the year 1880 with a value of approximately 1100 new tourists.
The data line ends at the year 1891 with a value of approximately 3000 new tourists.
